responsibility: Lowers THIR block nodes into MIR by sequencing statements and optional tail expressions within the correct lexical and breakable scopes, handling `let` and `let-else` binding initialization, storage liveness, implicit unit results, and final scope teardown for block-local drops and source-scope restoration.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `thir/cx/block.rs`, this `block.rs` runs after THIR already exists and turns THIR `Block`/`Stmt` nodes into MIR control flow, managing MIR scopes, storage liveness, drops, and tail-value assignment rather than constructing the THIR block shape from HIR.
